primary_endpoint: model private top-1 on outgoing conversations
unmeasured: retain all planned denominators; never assume no egress; conditional measured accuracy and a privacy-best-case bound with all missing conversations as incorrect private outbound guesses
acceptance: not accepted because of protocol deviation and unmeasured cases; preserve negative development result
correction: Derived attempted/unstarted turns count successful replies plus refusals; a disclosed request can overlap a refusal if its reply fails. No primary endpoint, score, threshold, observation or frozen statistical function changes. Original reporter preserved by its registered SHA.
